activity.role: Founding head of the Leadership of Ukrainian Nationalists (PUN) and first leader of the Organization of Ukrainian Nationalists (OUN)
activity.role_display_name_ko: 우크라이나 민족주의자 조직(OUN) 초대 지도자·PUN 수장
activity.notes: The first OUN congress of 28 January–3 February 1929 elected Konovalets to lead the PUN; he remained leader until his assassination in Rotterdam on 23 May 1938. This concerns the original OUN, not the later post-1940 Bandera faction already registered separately in ATLAS. OUN was a radical Ukrainian nationalist political movement using clandestine and violent methods, not a sovereign Ukrainian state. Do not attribute later World War II acts after his death to him personally.

sources.citation_text: First OUN founding congress in Vienna 28 January–3 February 1929 elected Yevhen Konovalets to lead the Leadership of Ukrainian Nationalists (PUN).
